programme.desc: Mesmo diante de toda a brutalidade e truculência da ditadura militar no Brasil, muitos artistas apresentavam-se como resistência utilizando do talento e da criatividade para driblar as imposições da censura na época. Além de fornecerem para a população uma espécie de válvula de escape, diversos humoristas foram ameaçados e perseguidos em detrimento de piadas e quadros televisivos. Alguns desses artistas prestam depoimentos e lembram deste conturbado momento na história do país.
programme.title: Tá Rindo de quê?

Agora, ele é convidado para voltar ao Congo, onde passou a maioria da sua vida, para servir como emissário de troca do parlamento britânico. O que Tarzan não sabe é que está se dirigindo para uma armadilha mortal, fruto da vingança do capitão belga Leon Rom.
programme.title: A Lenda de Tarzan

programme.desc: Um carcereiro tem um relacionamento incomum e comovente com um preso que está no corredor da morte: Coffey, um negro enorme, condenado por ter matado brutalmente duas gêmeas de nove anos. Ele tem tamanho e força para matar qualquer um, mas seu comportamento é completamente oposto à sua aparência. Além de ser simples, ingênuo e ter pavor do escuro, ele possui um dom sobrenatural. Com o passar do tempo, o carcereiro aprende que, às vezes, os milagres acontecem nos lugares mais inesperados.
programme.title: À Espera de um Milagre

programme.desc: Frank Abagnale Jr. já trabalhou como médico, advogado e copiloto, tudo isso antes de completar 18 anos. Mestre na arte do disfarce, ele aproveita suas habilidades para viver a vida como quer e praticar golpes milionários, que fazem com que se torne o ladrão de banco mais bem-sucedido da história dos Estados Unidos com apenas 17 anos. Mas em seu encalço está o agente do FBI Carl Hanratty, que usa todos os meios que tem ao seu dispor para encontrá-lo e capturá-lo, mas Frank está sempre à frente.
programme.title: Prenda-me se For Capaz

programme.desc: Em 2009, o mundo ficou em estado de choque quando o Capitão Chesley "Sully" Sullenberger conseguiu pousar um avião em pane no rio Hudson. A manobra quase impossível salvou a vida dos 150 passageiros e alçou Sully à categoria de herói nacional. No entanto, nem mesmo a aclamação pública foi capaz de impedir uma investigação rigorosa sobre sua reputação e carreira.
programme.title: Sully - O Herói do Rio Hudson

programme.desc: Desde sua ascensão ao estrelato, o ícone do rock Elvis Presley mantém um relacionamento complicado com seu enigmático empresário, Tom Parker, por mais de 20 anos.
programme.title: Elvis

programme.desc: Na infância, Danny Torrance sobreviveu a uma tentativa de homicídio por parte do pai, um escritor perturbado pelos espíritos malignos do Hotel Overlook. Já adulto, traumatizado e alcoólatra, Danny se estabelece em uma pequena cidade, onde consegue um emprego no hospital local. Sua paz, porém, está com os dias contados a partir de quando cria um vínculo telepático com Abra, uma menina com poderes tão fortes quanto aqueles que ele bloqueia dentro de si.
programme.title: Doutor Sono

programme.desc: S9 E17 — The Celebration Experimentation Pela primeira vez em nove anos, a turma toda decide comemorar o aniversário de Sheldon, que não gosta de festas por conta de um trauma na infância. Seus amigos, então, conseguem levar um convidado muito especial para surpreendê-lo no dia da festa.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

Os investigadores prendem um suspeito e descobrem que ele é um assassino em série responsável pelo estupro e assassinato de oito mulheres.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Sem Remorso Quando eram crianças, Reginald e Jonathan Carr viviam sem regras, bebendo álcool e praticando atos violentos. Depois de adultos, os irmãos aterrorizam uma cidade do Kansas.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Allen Kenneth e Kari Allen pareciam ser irmãos amorosos, até seus pais os separarem. Quando se reencontraram, anos depois, a dupla embarcou em uma onda de mortes e incesto.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S16 E4 — O Seu Ídolo Era Ted Bundy Debra vê o mal nos olhos do seu irmão mais novo, mas ela ainda não sabe que ele é um predador desviante e assassino em série.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S17 E10 — Ele Assobiava e Batia Ao acordar do coma, Melanie junta as peças do quebra-cabeça. Ela tinha tentado de tudo para que seu relacionamento com Tracy desse certo, apesar das suas mentiras e maus-tratos.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S3 E8 — A Luz Verde Em 1991, uma mulher leva sua filha a uma movimentada loja de produtos eletrônicos. Quase nove horas depois, ela se torna uma das sobreviventes de uma das maiores crises com reféns da história norte-americana.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S3 E9 — A Última Canção Em 2004, um show é interrompido quando um homem saca uma arma, dispara contra a banda e faz um refém. Enquanto os fãs fogem do local, a polícia enfrenta um atirador ativo antes da chegada dos reforços.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S3 E9 — Receita para um Assassinato Marilyn Reza é encontrada morta em sua casa e os investigadores interrogam os membros da igreja local em busca de um suspeito. Uma confissão inesperada em seu funeral revela os motivos do assassinato.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Bem-Vinda a Vizinhança Assassina Priscilla Strole, de 40 anos, tenta começar uma vida nova quando se muda com o filho adolescente, Kyle, para a pequena cidade de Fairfield, na Califórnia; ela não imagina que a mudança terminará com sua morte precoce.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Sob Controle Depois de dias sem ter notícias de Ramsay, seu filho, Donna Scrivo decide avisar a polícia. Seu pior pesadelo se torna realidade quando um corpo com a cabeça e os membros decepados é encontrado em uma estrada de terra.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E4 — O que Está por Trás Michelle Donohue sonha em se casar com um homem rico e prioriza o dinheiro acima de tudo. Mas quando finalmente encontra o homem certo, ele revela um lado sombrio que a leva a cometer um crime brutal.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Alguém Está Observando Ela Cindy Sumner desaparece em Toledo. Uma mensagem enigmática leva os detetives à rua Elm, onde descobrem uma obsessão sombria.
programme.title: Assassinatos na Rua Elm

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Mamãe Está Morta Após um menino de 3 anos sussurrar Mamãe está morta, a polícia descobre uma chacina na Rua Elm. Dois filhos sobrevivem.
programme.title: Assassinatos na Rua Elm

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Pesadelo Antes do Natal Na véspera de Natal, duas mulheres são encontradas amarradas e mortas. Sua ligação com a Rua Elm revela um assassino à solta.
programme.title: Assassinatos na Rua Elm

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Conto de Facas Uma ligação suspeita para a polícia leva a um estudante preso ao chão com uma faca, e o detetive Frank Dillard deve confiar em suas habilidades de interrogatório para chegar a um serial killer.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Adeus, Cavalos Uma jovem mãe é assassinada ao lado de uma casa de praia vazia. O detetive Plott descobre que ela foi atraída por uma ligação misteriosa, e logo percebe que o assassino está mais perto do que se imaginava.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S1 E8 — O Que Ela Viu Uma pacata cidade é abalada pelo brutal assassinato de um casal local. O detetive Bellino acredita que a chave para solucionar o crime é a filha das vítimas, portadora de deficiência e testemunha de ambas as mortes.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S1 E14 — Operações Delicadas O COPOM aciona o GATE para atuar no caso de uma mulher que faz um bebê de refém; o Centro de Operações dá apoio a policiais que perseguem um carro; câmeras de segurança ajudam a denunciar suspeitos de invadir uma casa.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S1 E15 — Cidade em Crise O COPOM monitora duas emergências policiais nada corriqueiras.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S5 E4 — Destruições e Explosões Uma mulher tem um colapso em um banco; um motorista causa danos materiais extremos; um confronto policial chega a um fim explosivo; uma mulher detida leva vantagem sobre a polícia.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S5 E8 — Más Intenções Uma mulher desequilibrada abre fogo dentro de uma delegacia de polícia; a polícia pega um homem bisbilhotando seus vizinhos; uma mulher tropeça em um convidado inesperado na cama de seu filho; um herói tenta salvar um policial em dificuldades.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S5 E9 — Pegando Criminosos Um homem foge de seu colega de quarto que empunha um machado; piratas de varanda são flagrados por câmeras arruinando o dia das pessoas; um grupo de adolescentes caça dois ladrões de pacotes; a polícia recebe ajuda de um animal improvável.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S5 E11 — Bêbados, Pizza e Bandidos Um pai defende sua família de um grupo de agressores; um entregador de pizza se torna um herói improvável; um idoso armado chega ao limite; um homem Amish embriagado tem um infeliz encontro com a polícia.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S19 E2 — Eu Não Sou o Meu Pai Daniel Bible já havia sobrevivido ao inferno e escapado dele. Ele fazia o possível para esquecer o demônio com quem conviveu por oito anos: seu pai. Contudo, ele ainda desconhece a extensão dos crimes horrendos cometidos por ele.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S4 E1 — Caubói Assassinado A cidade rural de Emmett, no Idaho, onde a palavra de uma pessoa é tudo, fica abalada quando um fabricante de selas é assassinado; os investigadores e os moradores locais se unem para revelar um rastro de traição e mentiras.
programme.title: Cidade Pacata, Crime Cruel

programme.desc: S5 E1 — Avisos Sussurrados A comunidade de Kankakee, no Illinois, se une para ajudar a polícia a descobrir o cruel assassino que acabou com a carreira promissora da modelo Sarah Washington.
programme.title: Cidade Pacata, Crime Cruel

programme.desc: S10 E6 — Desprezível e Horrível Uma jovem mãe desaparece e seu marido se junta à busca. Inicialmente, os detetives o consideram um típico pai suburbano, mas descobrem que um psicopata assassino se esconde ali.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S10 E8 — É para Vocês Descobrirem Após as mortes de um pai, mãe e dois adolescentes em uma casa no subúrbio de Baltimore, os investigadores percebem que não foi um roubo que deu errado, mas sim a execução de uma família amorosa, feita por um assassino psicopata insensível.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Cabana 13 Um pastor e sua esposa são atacados em uma cabana isolada. A polícia investiga o passado do casal e descobre uma lista de suspeitos.
programme.title: Crimes na Cabana

programme.desc: S4 E10 — Invasão de Domicílio Depois de se separar de um homem abusivo, Julie Curry Boyd se muda com os filhos para a casa de seu pai. Ela não imagina que ambos serão vítimas da fúria assassina do ex-marido.
programme.title: Seu Pior Pesadelo

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Segredos Expostos Em uma cidade de Oklahoma, Mark e Dee Stepp são encontrados mortos em sua casa por sua única filha, Francine, de 19 anos. Os Stepps pareciam a família perfeita, até os detetives descobrirem um segredo que levou às mortes.
programme.title: Mentiras Criminosas

programme.desc: S7 E10 — Assassinos Malfadados Depois que uma mãe solteira não comparece ao trabalho, a polícia a encontra brutalmente esfaqueada e sua filha desaparecida de sua casa em um rico condomínio fechado. Todos temem que ela esteja em perigo, mas o que descobrem é ainda mais sombrio.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Pesadelo em Casa O sequestro e assassinato de uma líder de torcida popular choca uma cidade. Um segundo homicídio sinistramente similar somente duas semanas depois apavora a comunidade, que passa a suspeitar de um assassino em série.

programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Sexo, Drogas e Traição Após anos de problemas com sua filha Delores, Pauline a manda para morar com seu pai. Será que a volta de Delores vai piorar a hostilidade entre as duas?

programme.desc: S16 E1 — Ele Tirou a Vida que Salvou Betty percebe o lado sombrio do sobrinho desde cedo, mas não consegue salvar a irmã de seus ataques violentos.

programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Terror à Espreita; Ficha Suja Câmeras de segurança em Ohio registram um tiroteio que mata um menino de três anos; em Louisiana, o filho de um policial é baleado em uma casa noturna, o que leva a uma caçada interestadual.
programme.title: Crime em Tempo Real

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Estado de Sítio; Onde Está Chynna? Em Dallas, tiros matam um homem no 4 de julho e os investigadores buscam a verdade; uma fumaça se espalha em um incêndio em Washington e a polícia descobre que houve um assassinato e tudo foi gravado.
programme.title: Crime em Tempo Real

programme.desc: S2 E6 — O Monstro Latashia Bradfield está tranquila em sua casa quando batem à sua porta. São os filhos de seu vizinho, frenéticos, e ao telefone com a emergência. Ela corre para checar o que houve e se depara com um circo de horrores.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Laura Uma jovem conclui a faculdade, mas desaparece antes de poder começar uma vida nova. Os investigadores do caso descobrem evidências de um crime brutal e encontram um suspeito ligado a um caso anterior.

programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S3 E6 — Temporada 3 Episódio 6 Um bairro da Filadélfia Oeste fica em choque quando uma estrela do atletismo do ensino médio desaparece sem deixar rastro.

programme.desc: Special A influenciadora Gabby Petito é dada como desaparecida e gera uma grande busca. Pela primeira vez, imagens dela com o parceiro são analisadas e especialistas identificam sinais de uma relação abusiva e da tragédia que viria.

programme.title: People Magazine: Sobrevivendo a um Serial Killer

programme.desc: S1 E3 — No Limite do Desespero Uma mulher implora a um sequestrador que a leve em vez de seu filho. Durante dias, ela fica à mercê do criminoso e percebe que, para sobreviver, precisa fazer com que ele se apaixone por ela.
programme.title: People Magazine: Sobrevivendo a um Serial Killer

programme.desc: S1 E2 — O Assassino da Ferrovia Um casal de namorados é atacado por um sádico durante uma caminhada noturna pelos trilhos de uma estrada de ferro. A garota se torna a única sobrevivente do Assassino da Ferrovia.
programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Atendimento Rápido Dia movimentado no COPOM; policiais militares e Grupo de Ações Táticas Especiais são mobilizados; COPOM acompanha viaturas em terra na busca por carro roubado.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Desentendimentos e Perseguição Homem, portando faca, se recusa a dialogar com as equipes enviadas para solucionar o caso e o Gate é acionado; desentendimento em um motel exige presença policial; uma perseguição por suspeitos de roubo tem suporte em tempo real do Copom.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S4 E5 — Intrusos Indesejados Intrusos armados apavoram adolescentes enquanto os pais assistem pela câmera de segurança; funcionários falsos do governo roubam moradores; dois ladrões amadores são detidos.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S4 E1 — Movimentos Arriscados Uma vítima se recusa a desistir quando é atropelada por um ladrão; um segurança desarmado enfrenta um atirador; pessoas corajosas enfrentam as chamas de um carro pegando fogo; um guarda arrisca a vida para salvar uma criança.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S4 E2 — Sem Saída Um funcionário é mais esperto que ladrões armados; uma mãe age rapidamente quando seu filho é roubado na rua; alguém ataca uma mulher na entrada de casa; um assaltante fica entalado.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S4 E10 — Criminosos Destemidos Ladrões roubam conversores catalíticos nas garagens das pessoas; uma mulher com um machado arrisca a vida de um bebê; um perseguidor sequestra uma mulher; carros se tornam armas em roubos violentos.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Estado de Sítio; Onde Está Chynna? Em Dallas, tiros matam um homem no 4 de julho e os investigadores buscam a verdade; uma fumaça se espalha em um incêndio em Washington e a polícia descobre que houve um assassinato e tudo foi gravado.
programme.title: Crime em Tempo Real

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Área de Caça San Diego entra em pânico após a polícia encontrar o corpo de Cara Knott descartado em uma ponte rodoviária. Com evidências inconclusivas e a população clamando por justiça, a polícia deve trabalhar rapidamente para encontrar o culpado e puni-lo.
programme.title: Policial Bom, Policial Mau

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Espere o Inesperado Pessoas desavisadas presenciam uma cena que não esquecem tão cedo; um hóspede descontrolado aterroriza desconhecidos no "Lugar Mais Feliz da Terra".
programme.title: Pelados e Condenados

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Aviões, Trens e Automóveis Uma pessoa nua ameaça a paz no transporte público; um posto de fiscalização em um aeroporto do Texas mergulha no caos.
programme.title: Pelados e Condenados

programme.desc: S9 E7 — Policial Ferido Na Virgínia, um chefe de polícia é baleado por um ladrão de lojas e precisa enfrentar o atirador sozinho. No Novo México, um assalto violento termina em uma perseguição em alta velocidade e tiros disparados contra a polícia.
programme.title: Bodycam - Registros Criminosos

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Licença para Atacar Um motorista furioso colide com um prédio; motoristas da Flórida enfrentam o caos nas estradas; motoristas de Nova Jersey tentam sobreviver ao trajeto diário para o trabalho; um homem irritado começa uma briga com um motoboy.
programme.title: Fúria no Trânsito

programme.desc: S3 E1 — Párias no Trânsito Caminhoneiros enfrentam motoristas irritados; um garoto é atacado por um motorista enfurecido; um homem usa spray de pimenta para acalmar um motorista furioso; uma mulher persegue um motorista que a teria prejudicado.
programme.title: Fúria no Trânsito

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Não Podemos Garantir Sua Segurança Duas mães enfrentam o seu pior temor: o sequestro de seus filhos. Os negociadores usam mensagens de texto para salvar um bebê e recorrem à própria experiência como pais para convencer um suspeito a se entregar.
programme.title: Na Mira dos Sequestradores

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Fúria Secreta Para Sarah Wisnosky, de 17 anos, a faculdade oferece uma série de experiências novas e instigantes. Quando começa a sair com o membro de uma fraternidade, ela descobre que ele tem um lado sombrio.
programme.title: Seu Pior Pesadelo

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Problema de Afeição Latrese Curtis, de 21 anos, foi esfaqueada até a morte perto de uma rodovia da Carolina do Norte. Quando detetives descobrem que Latrese levava uma vida dupla, revelam uma história de ciúme, raiva e amor não correspondido.
programme.title: Mentiras Criminosas

programme.desc: S6 E6 — O Diabo em Jasper O assassinato de James Byrd Jr. gera um caos na família da vítima e leva as autoridades a investigarem um dos piores crimes de ódio da história dos Estados Unidos.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Assassinato no Muck Bowl Em 2008, Norman Griffith, astro de futebol americano da escola Pahokee, é morto a tiros na entrada de um baile em Belle Glade, na Flórida, onde fica o maior rival esportivo de seu time. A investigação revela uma traição.
programme.title: Assassinato de uma Sexta à Noite

programme.desc: S3 E10 — Alguém Sabe As famílias de um estudante universitário e de uma mãe de cinco filhos ficam em choque quando seus entes queridos desaparecem e surgem conspirações complexas.
programme.title: Ainda um Mistério

programme.desc: S9 E6 — A Última Aposta Policiais de Lansing encontram o corpo de Donovan Barfield com múltiplos ferimentos de tiros. Enquanto tentam identificar o autor do crime, é descoberto um plano de homicídio e roubo tramado por um trio de assassinos imprudentes.
programme.title: Câmera Crime

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Eu o Matei A polícia atende a um chamado e encontra um pai de família morto em casa com mais de 15 tiros. Quando interrogam a família, os agentes não encontram a sogra da vítima.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S3 E3 — Dano Mortal O corpo nu e mutilado de uma mulher é encontrado no fundo de uma ravina da Louisiana. Marcas de pneu levam a polícia a um suspeito e um assassino em série é revelado. Ele confessa que matou oito mulheres ao longo de uma década.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S4 E1 — Sentença de Morte O assassino do torniquete apavorou jovens em Houston, no Texas. Quando avanços no DNA finalmente levam à sua prisão, o psicopata confessa vários homicídios. Semanas antes de sua execução, ele concedeu uma entrevista.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S4 E7 — Disputa entre Irmãos A família Fuss acredita que todos os seus sonhos estão se tornando realidade. No entanto, a rivalidade entre irmãos rapidamente se espalha e acaba saindo do controle. E, diante desse cenário, o que todos sempre temeram finalmente acontece.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S4 E1 — A Luta de Uma Mãe Um médico e sua esposa vivem a vida dos sonhos com suas lindas filhas. No entanto, quando o casamento começa a apresentar uma série de problemas, o lado violento do marido vem à tona e o sonho se transforma em pesadelo.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S17 E8 — Ele Ainda me Assombra Abbi percebe que seu namorado tem um lado sombrio e espera que a paternidade o transforme. Quando a crueldade dele se torna insuportável, ela vai embora de casa, mas descobre que ele sempre foi um monstro.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S17 E3 — Escuridão Paterna Lisa sabe que seu pai é cruel e não consegue entender por que sua mãe fica com ele, mas ela não tem ideia de quão mau ele realmente é.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Um Dia de Fúria Em uma manhã de 1994, um aluno do ensino médio mantém sua classe como refém sob a mira de uma arma; alunos, professores e policiais temem o pior, mas não imaginam que um massacre está prestes a acontecer.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Sete Minutos e Meio Em meados da década de 1980, um promotor de Wichita Falls, no Texas, EUA, tem uma série de homicídios brutais para solucionar; o luto de um pai o leva a confrontar o assassino de sua filha; um homem é acusado de matar a esposa.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Temporada 2 Episódio 6 Becky Stowe, de 15 anos, desaparece misteriosamente e todas as pessoas que ela conhece são potenciais suspeitas. A verdade sobre sua morte só é revelada com uma denúncia inesperada.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Decidido a Trair Joan Bent é assassinada e a polícia investiga uma série de suspeitos. Quando uma pista provoca uma reviravolta no caso, ninguém acredita na identidade do assassino.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Melhores Amigos Após sair em segredo para ir a uma festa, José Najera, de 19 anos, volta para casa e encontra seus pais mortos no chão do quarto. A polícia trabalha com a hipótese de latrocínio, mas a verdade é ainda mais perversa.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Um Acidente à Espera Rainey Morin é uma mãe solteira que finalmente encontra sua alma gêmea. Robert Kowalski é gentil com Rainey e os filhos dela, mas sob a aparência simpática, ele esconde um passado sombrio que terá consequências mortais.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E1 — As Duas Caras de Stephen Collins Durante dez anos, Stephen Collins representou um pai e pastor de comportamento irrepreensível no programa "7th Heaven". Em outubro de 2014, seu mundo desmorona quando ele admite abusar de garotas menores de idade.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S1 E5 — A Maldição da Garra de Ferro Seis irmãos formam uma dinastia de lutadores, mas cinco morrem ainda jovens. O único sobrevivente conta como a fama, os vícios e personagens excêntricos se tornam a maldição do negócio familiar.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Indiscrição Fatal Jill Ann Spaulding sonha em se tornar modelo da Playboy, mas quando chega à mansão de Hugh Hefner, suas expectativas são frustradas. Após escrever um livro sobre o assunto, Jill morre de forma misteriosa.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S3 E1 — Última Dança Após o fim do namoro, uma bela assistente de audições da Playboy entra sozinha na vida noturna de Los Angeles pela primeira vez.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Acidente, Invasão e Negociação A Rota cerca uma mansão invadida, onde suspeitos mantém o proprietário refém. O Gate também é acionado para negociar rendição; um acidente de trânsito com homem armado é supervisionado por policiais e bombeiros.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S2 E7 — Ações Policiais Suspeito de furtar moto se nega a ir à delegacia e comunidade se revolta com a ação policial; outras viaturas averiguam um roubo a motel.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S4 E6 — Pego de Surpresa Idas de rotina ao mercado se tornam assustadoras; uma jovem é agredida andando pela rua; um tiroteio começa no meio do trânsito; funcionários cansados atacam um ladrão persistente.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S4 E8 — Quem Está Observando Ladrões focam em uma família que está comprando joias; postos de gasolina se tornam perigosos quando criminosos atacam motoristas; um atendente calmo enfrenta um assaltante armado.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Sequestradores de Criança Cenas de terror em plena luz do dia deixam duas mães horrorizadas; um estranho tenta pegar um bebê de um carrinho; outro homem quase leva uma criança de dentro de um restaurante, mas bons samaritanos correm para ajudar.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Perigo na Rua Uma mulher enfrenta seu pior pesadelo: ser seguida por um estranho a caminho de casa. Assustada, ela tenta gravá-lo no celular enquanto foge; um ataque violento e sem motivo a uma criança dançando na rua gera revolta.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S9 E7 — A Garota da Bicicleta Em 1972, Jody Loomis, de 20 anos, sai para um passeio de bicicleta no final da tarde para visitar seu cavalo e nunca mais volta para casa. Ela é encontrada assassinada na floresta, e seu caso intriga as autoridades locais.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Plymouth, Missouri with the Light Heavyweight World Title on the line as Champ Emanuel Newton takes on journeyman Joey Beltran.

programme.title: Bellator 131: Ortiz vs. Bonnar
programme.desc: The talking is over. Bonnar. Ortiz. Time to fight.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards

programme.sub-title: Preparations for War! A Decisive Battle in Level 4 - Blazing Hell

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into Second Gear!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy hovers perilously on the verge of death, Bon Clay embarks on a suicidal rescue mission plagued by sub-zero temperatures and bloodthirsty wolves with a supremely savage disposition!
programme.sub-title: FOR HIS FRIEND! BON CLAY'S DEADLY RESCUE ATTEMPT

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!
programme.sub-title: A PARADISE IN HELL / IMPEL DOWN LEVEL 5.5

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan's agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY'S TREATMENT BEGINS / IVA'S MIRACULOUS POWER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy's still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!
programme.sub-title: BELIEVE IN MIRACLES! BON CLAY'S CRIES FROM THE HEART

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he's far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission – until he learns of Luffy's lineage!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY BACK IN ACTION! IVA BEGINS THE BREAKOUT PLAN!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan's scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!
programme.sub-title: ACE'S CONVOY BEGINS / BATTLE ON THE LOWEST FLOOR, LEVEL 6!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: JET PISTOL OF ANGER! LUFFY VS. BLACKBEARD!

programme.sub-title: MAGELLAN'S TRICKY MOVE! A FOILED ESCAPE PLAN!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: COME, FINAL MIRACLE! BREAK THROUGH THE GATE OF JUSTICE!

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sins of the Sister
programme.desc: A sisterly bond can mean a life full of friendship and sibling love. But for some women, having a sister means nothing more then having their own personal meal ticket, scapegoat and combatant. These types of relationships can lead to deadly outcomes.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Kill For Cash
programme.desc: Money is a strong motivator. It can be used for good. It can be used for evil. It can be the driving force behind murder. These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Deadly Delinquents
programme.desc: In the tormented mind of a young school girl, jealousy can turn to a murderous rage. These deadly girls turn on their own and kill their friends. This is the brutal world of deadly delinquents.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Killer Kids
programme.desc: For many parents, their children's teen years can be one big headache. But when typical teenage rebellion turns into deadly rage, a parent's love may not be enough to save their life.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Breaking Point
programme.desc: Anger, fear and despair are basic human emotions. But when these emotions are coupled with a broken mind, a perfect storm is created. Teetering on the edge of unbalance, these women resort to murder when pushed to the breaking point.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970's and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Could vampires be real? A well-known U.S. paranormal investigator and folklorist in New York City recounts the legend and evolution of the vampire throughout history and from culture to culture.

programme.title: Myth Hunters

programme.desc: The discovery of an ancient copper scroll in a Jordanian cave leads to a lifelong quest by a young British scholar in the search for lost Jewish Treasure.

programme.desc: A young woman named Kristy has been haunted in her own bedroom since she can remember. Now it's up to Ryan and the crew to help Kristy before she's overwhelmed by the entity.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Dwelling of the Dead
programme.desc: A single mom claims she is being physically assaulted by a spirit in her Kentucky home. Ryan first explores a natural explanation for the alleged phenomena. But the client's five-year-old son also sees spirits, and his sightings appear to line up.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Dead Legends
programme.desc: PRS and Psychic/Medium Chip Coffey investigate the famed Hotel Conneaut in northern Pennsylvania. Heavy doors opening on their own, sightings of a boy, a bride and a menacing butcher have the hotel's staff on edge.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Sex Dungeon
programme.desc: Psychic/Medium Chip Coffey and Chad Calek join PRS for this unusual case of a sprawling mansion on Greyhaven Island near Detroit. Ken, the owner, hears voices and banging and it has him feeling both watched and cursed; a prisoner in his own home.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Sickness
programme.desc: Something is making Lisa and her family sick. Is it natural or paranormal? Ryan and the team uncover the tragic history surrounding Lisa's home--with shocking connections to respiratory illness.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Good Vs. Evil
programme.desc: PRS visits a western Pennsylvania couple wracked by a torrent of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Get Out of This House
programme.desc: When an aggressive spirit stalks a young family, PRS is called in to investigate. When it is determined that the source of the haunting may have been unknowingly invited in, Ryan races to identify and hopefully defeat the entity before it's too late.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Devil in Jersey
programme.desc: PRS delves deep into the pine barrens of the Garden State to separate myth from reality about the so-called "Jersey Devil." Accompanied by a cryptozoologist the team interviews eye witnesses and experts in search of the truth.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Who Is the Lurking Man?
programme.desc: PRS travels to Newcastle, CA to investigate a house with paranormal forces so strong, the family has cleared out. Ryan believes the Native American land may hold the key to the mystery and leads the team in a fight to reclaim a scared family's house.

programme.title: Paranormal State: They Only Come Out at Night
programme.desc: Once night falls in a quaint?New England Town, a police officer's family is terrorized by demons.?PRS arrives just in time with the family ready to vacate their family home, rather than suffer the advances of these spirit creatures.
programme.sub-title: They Only Come Out at Night

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Drowned
programme.desc: Kim and her family have been frightened out of their seaside Maryland home. Multiple family members have reported sightings of children with purple lips and strange noises emanating from the nearby creek.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Invitation to Evil
programme.desc: Paula and her husband Mike are under siege by a purported shadow demon in their North Carolina home. Paula has witnessed a toddler bed levitating and heard deep growls. Michelle, Ryan and the team uncover the shocking truth behind the haunting.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Cemetery
programme.desc: PRS visits a gothic graveyard, where a jealous spirit seems to be preying on the newlywed wife of the cemetery's caretaker. Ryan traces the haunting to a mysterious, unclaimed cremation urn on the grounds.

programme.title: Paranormal State: If I Should Die...

programme.desc: Saltmarshe Hall is a mysterious, haunted house of complete contrasts. Beneath the property lies a network of corridors and cellar rooms and the abandoned North Wing has sat empty for over 70 years,

programme.title: Dynasty: The Surrogate, Pt. 1
programme.desc: Sean accepts Alexis' job offer, immediately putting him at odds with Adam; Dana is tortured by a secret from the past explaining her inability to have children; Jeff and Fallon continue to grow farther apart.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Surrogate, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Alexis undermines Blake's public opinion with a viperous editorial in her paper; Dana's enthusiasm for a surrogate falters when she suspects Adam finds the other woman more attractive.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Primary
programme.desc: A passionate weekend leads Alexis to accept Sean's impulsive marriage proposal; Sammy Jo gives into Josh Harris' passionate advances; celebrating Blake's primary election victory, Adam tells Blake he is going to have another grandchild.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Testing
programme.desc: Blake asks Steven to Run Denver-Carrington; Leslie succeeds in seducing Jeff; Sammy Jo struggles with her lingering love for Steven and her passion for Josh, as Josh is consumed by his cocaine addiction.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Set-Up
programme.desc: Alexis schemes to prevent Dana from legally adopting Adam's surrogate child; Adam anonymously informs the press of drug problems on Steven's football team; Steven discovers a powerful secret in Dana's past.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Fair
programme.desc: Sean threatens Dana with blackmail unless she helps him gather incriminating information against the Carrington family; Josh Harris is devastated by Sammy Jo's rejection of his wedding proposal; Fallon asks Jeff for a divorce.

programme.title: Dynasty: The New Moguls
programme.desc: After meeting with Cora Van Husen, Krystle obtains a copy of the scandalous video, proving Blake's innocence; Dex discovers Sean is somehow involved with unsavory characters proposing a multi-million dollar oil venture to Denver-Carrington.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Spoiler
programme.desc: Following Josh Harris' death, Sammy Jo realizes she must let go of Steven; upset by Steven's uncompromising use of power, Fallon drifts further away from her brother; Dana gives the notes of Denver-Carrington's board meeting to Sean.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Interview
programme.desc: Sean uses Alexis' bid for governor to gain control of Colbyco; Sammy Jo and Jeff develop a deep friendship from their mutual loneliness; Dana tells Adam he was the father of her aborted baby. As Adams turns to Karen for solace.

programme.title: Dynasty: Images
programme.desc: Krystle discovers damaging information regarding Alexis' marriage to Cecil Colby, Leslie follows Sean to his father's grave, learning his true identity as Joseph Aynders' son; Dana returns to Adam and the two quietly forget the past.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Rifle
programme.desc: Forced by Adam and Fallon's vote, Steven reluctantly agrees to authorize the Vitron oil deal, as Sean's maniacal scheme to avenge his father's death begins to unfold; Krystle obtains a copy of Cecil Colby's original will.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Bracelet
programme.desc: Encouraged by her popular support after the shooting, Alexis decides to stay in the race; Sean speeds his plan to use the Vitron oil deal to crush Alexis; Karen is unnerved by the return of her ex-husband.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Warning
programme.desc: Tired of Leslie's threats to expose his true identity, Sean plants a poisonous snake in her room as a warning of who she is dealing with; having second thoughts about accepting Adam's bribe to stay away from Karen, Jesse gives the money back.

programme.title: Dynasty: Adam's Son
programme.desc: Karen is rushed to the hospital to the hospital as she goes into labor; after Sean threatens Leslie, she confides in Dex, Sean's true identity; Dex warns Alexis that Sean may be seeking vengeance against her as she listens in horror.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Scandal
programme.desc: Alexis warns Blake about Sean's true identity. Concerned for his family's safety, Blake and Dex go to Natumbre to uncover Sean's mysterious scheme involving the Vitron oil deal.

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Weighs In/The Law of the Jungle Gym
programme.desc: When Arthur doesn't fit into his costume for the play, he's shocked to learn that he's gotten "husky-sized." He gets serious about getting in shape. Muffy found the perfect place to take pictures with her new digital camera: the jungle gym.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Weighs In/The Law of the Jungle Gym

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Writes A Story/Arthur's Lost Dog
programme.desc: Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Writes A Story/Arthur's Lost Dog

programme.title: Arthur: Swept Away/Germophobia
programme.desc: Arthur, D.W. and Buster are spending a few days at the beach. Can they save their sandcastle from the ocean tides? Buster's friends have had enough of his sloppy habits, so they band together to educate him on the realities of bacteria.

programme.title: Arthur's First Day
programme.desc: It's finally the first day of fourth grade and Arthur couldn't be more excited - until he learns Buster is in another class! Meanwhile, D.W. is nervous for her first day of kindergarten. Will Arthur and D.W. be able to make new friends?

programme.title: Arthur: When Carl Met George/D.W. Swims with the Fishes
programme.desc: George is excited about his new friend, Carl. Then George learns that Carl has Asperger's Syndrome – can they remain good friends? D.W. and James enter the pre-school swim meet and recruit their big siblings to coach them.
programme.sub-title: When Carl Met George/D.W. Swims with the Fishes

programme.title: Arthur: Shelter from the Storm (Part 1 & 2)
programme.desc: When a powerful hurricane hits Elwood City, everyone's affected. Ladonna's dad is called up by the Army Corps of Engineers. Muffy relocates to a shelter. And Arthur struggles to reunite lost pets and owners.

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Makes A Movie/Go To Your Room!
programme.desc: Too young to see a real "James Hound" movie, the kids decide they'll make a film of their own. Next, how would YOU like to be four years old and completely misunderstood by your parents? And then be sent to your room for ten whole minutes?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes A Movie/Go To Your Room!

programme.title: Arthur: The Pea and the Princess/D.W. and Dr. Whosit
programme.desc: The 3rd grade class is putting on a production of “The Princess and the Pea,” and Prunella is at the helm as director! Then, Mom and Dad tell D.W. she’s too young to watch a new television show that everyone is talking about.
programme.sub-title: The Pea and the Princess/D.W. and Dr. Whosit

programme.title: Arthur: The Making of Arthur/Dancing Fools
programme.desc: When Matt Damon puts out a call for homemade videos for his TV show, he sets off a frantic rush as Arthur and his gang film their lives. Mrs. Molina is a teaching a dance class for kids. Will Francine and George be the next Fred and Ginger?

programme.title: Arthur: Buster's Breathless/The Fright Stuff
programme.desc: Will Buster's friends treat him the same after they learn he has asthma? Prankster have arrived in Elwood City--just in time for the "Scare Your Pants Off" costume party! It's boys vs. girls in what becomes a great big battle of the pranks.

programme.title: Arthur: My Club Rules/Stolen Bike
programme.desc: The gang can't agree on rules for their club, and each starts his own. Next, Francine's embarrassed by her crummy old bike. Why can't she have a shiny new one like all her friends?

programme.title: Arthur: The Chronicles of Buster/On this Spot
programme.desc: Buster learns that special effects can't take the place of hard work when conquering real mountains. Arthur is thrilled to find out that Sitting Bull once passed through town! He rallies the residents to mark the spot with a monument.
programme.sub-title: The Chronicles of Buster/On this Spot

programme.title: Arthur: Buster Spaces Out/The Long Road Home
programme.desc: Inspired by footage of the moon landing, Buster wants to go to outer space someday! For now, it'd be cool to build and launch a rocket! Then, after costing Lakewood Elementary the win in a relay race, George wants to redeem himself.
programme.sub-title: Buster Spaces Out/The Long Road Home

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Family Vacation/Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm
programme.desc: What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Family Vacation/Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's First Sleepover/Arthur's New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Have you ever been afraid of the dark? Despite D.W.'s threat of aliens, Arthur sets his tent for his first sleepover. Then, what exactly happens at midnight, December 31st? There are plenty of rumors, but no one seems to know for sure.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's First Sleepover/Arthur's New Year's Eve

programme.title: Arthur: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat
programme.desc: Does Binky have a favorite pastime? Not until citywide Bug Week, when suddenly all he can think about is butterflies. Then, there's a horrible racket in Elwood City, and it's Francine practicing her singing and drumming for the Talent Show!
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat

programme.title: Arthur: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!
programme.desc: It's the duel of the century as cellist Yo-Yo Ma faces jazz saxophonist Joshua Redman in the toughest gig of their careers at the Elwood City Library! Then, will Arthur be exposed as a baby show lover?
programme.sub-title: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Sells Out/Mind Your Manners
programme.desc: To earn the money for a new video game, Arthur decides to sell his old toys through his school's Web site. The Tibble Twins want to take Grandmother out to dinner, but she'd rather stay home. Is it because of their terrible table manners?

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine
programme.desc: Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.
programme.sub-title: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Meets Mister Rogers/Draw!
programme.desc: Mister Rogers is staying at Arthur's house! Mister Rogers is a nice guy, but... his show is for babies! Can Arthur hide the visit from his friends? Next, the trouble starts when Fern draws a not-too-flattering cartoon of Francine.

programme.title: Arthur: Binky Wrestles with a Story/All Will Be Revealed
programme.desc: Binky spends the day with Bitzi Baxter and learns what it's like to be a news reporter. Then, D.W., Bud, and Rapty set out to solve the mystery of what really happened to D.W.'s snowball.
programme.sub-title: Binky Wrestles with a Story/All Will Be Revealed

programme.title: Arthur: Cents-less/Buster the Lounge Lizard
programme.desc: Mr. Ratburn decides it's time for his class to learn a little about money. For the entire weekend, no one in the class can spend a cent. Buster has the brand-new Dark Bunny Dark Buggy, complete with grappling hook and voice commands!

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. on Ice/Spoiled Rotten!
programme.desc: D.W. tells her friends that she's a fantastic skater, but she can barely stand on ice! With a skating party coming up, how will she face everyone and tell them the truth? Accused of being spoiled, Muffy sets out to prove her friends wrong.

programme.title: Arthur: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever
programme.desc: Arthur thinks his jokes about Sue Ellen's new sweater are in good fun but Sue Ellen's feelings are hurt. Has Arthur become a bully? Everyone is reminiscing about their "best days." Except Arthurs. Is it possible he doesn't have one?
programme.sub-title: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever

programme.title: The Rhythm and Roots of Arthur
programme.desc: Pack your bags, buckle your seatbelts, and get ready for an ARTHUR road trip to the family farm! Arthur’s Great-Grand Uncle Theo is celebrating his 85th birthday, so the Reads (and Buster) are off to Ohio to join in the festivities.

programme.title: Arthur: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal
programme.desc: It’s Lakewood Elementary Parents Open House! How will the kids survive a whole evening of their parents' embarrassing antics? Buster is the only kid in Elwood City who doesn't have a Cybertoy, so he decides to 'borrow' one from the store.
programme.sub-title: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal

programme.title: Arthur: Around the World in 11 Minutes/Muffy and the Big Bad Blog
programme.desc: Pal, Baby Kate, Amigo, and Mei Lin enthusiastically accept Nemo's dare to travel around the world and make it back in 11 minutes. Then, Muffy discovers that web blogging is a great way to keep her readers up to date with her every move.
programme.sub-title: Around the World in 11 Minutes/Muffy and the Big Bad Blog

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team
programme.desc: In D.W.’s heart lurks one big, gnawing desire--TO GET RID OF THOSE TRAINING WHEELS! Then, can Coach Frensky work with a baseball team where everyone is fighting about who gets to be pitcher and no one wants to practice?
programme.sub-title: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team

programme.title: Arthur: Caught in the Crosswires/Framed
programme.desc: Muffy is thrilled when mega producer J3 chooses her family for his latest reality TV project. After all, she was born to be star! Buster has just won the best young artist award at the Elwood City Arts Festival.

programme.title: Arthur: Based on a True Story (Part 1 & 2)
programme.desc: There's a new kid in town: Ladonna Compson, the Louisiana native with the gift of gab. Ladonna charms Arthur and friends with her amazing "true" stories. But are her stories really fact…or fiction?

programme.title: Pacific Inferno: Warriors of WWII
programme.desc: The end of World War II in the Pacific was marked by dropping atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945, prompting Japan's surrender, formalized on September 2, 1945, aboard the USS Missouri, effectively ending the conflict in the Pacific.
programme.sub-title: Pacific Inferno: Warriors of WWII - Episode 010

programme.title: Hitler & The Nazis
programme.desc: Supreme Commander: Explores the Berlin Olympic Games and the rise of Adolf Hitler as the Supreme Commander of the German Reich.

programme.title: Hitler & The Nazis
programme.desc: Conquering France: Examines the Conquest of France in 1940 by Hitler's forces.

programme.title: Hitler & The Nazis
programme.desc: Peak of Power: Documenting the peak of Hitler's power and his plan to invade Great Britain.

programme.title: Hitler & The Nazis
programme.desc: The fall of a hate-fueled and manipulative madman, and those who faithfully followed him from the invasion at Normandy, the death camps of Auschwitz-Birkenau, the military failure at Stalingrad, and the fall of Berlin.

programme.title: Anzacs: In The Face Of War
programme.desc: 'ANZACS In the Face of War' presents an historical profile of Australia and new Zealand at the outbreak of war. The legacy of WWI the shared experiences and expectations of WWII.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: To commemorate the 70th Anniversary of the Battle of Britain Ewan and Colin McGregor take to the skies to discover how; against the odds, the RAF inflicted Hitler's first defeat of WW2.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: Heroism was not unique to US commanders, these generals battled the Nazis on all fronts. A look at Bernard Law Montgomery, Georgi Zhukov, and Sir Arthur Harris.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: The commanders of World War II who led on the high seas and on the homefront. Charles Nimitz, George Marshall, and Joseph Stillwell are seen in profile.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: From Island-hopping to thirty seconds over Tokyo, this is a look at the battles of Douglas MacArthur, Hap Arnold, and James Doolittle.

programme.title: Anzacs: In The Face Of War
programme.desc: 'ANZACS In the Face of War' presents an historical profile of Australia and new Zealand at the outbreak of war. The legacy of WWI the shared experiences and expectations of WWII.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: After being paralysed as a teenager, Robert met Ashleigh online and they fell in love. With news he may not have much longer to live, Robert asks Nev and Max to bring Ashleigh to him. (S6, ep16)

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Robin is desperate to meet her hunky, long-distance love in person. Nev and Max agree to help her hunt him down, but what they uncover turns out to be much more than Robin bargained for! (S6, ep17)

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: For years, Nicole has had her pictures stolen to make fake profiles, one of which has been catfishing Ryan for ten years. Ryan and Nicole are unsure whether it's a random troll, or they have a common enemy.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Jasmine writes to Nev and Max asking for help for a "friend". But they're perplexed when Jasmine drops a bombshell revelation: they've helped her friend before! (S6, ep19)

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Sunny & Jamison
programme.desc: Sunny is in love with the man of her dreams. Jamison is a model, a TV writer, and also studying to be an anaesthesiologist. However, the pair have never met. Is Jamison too good to be true?

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Trina & Scorpio
programme.desc: Trina is a dancer who always had trouble meeting trustworthy guys, until she met Scorpio, a fellow dancer, online. Will Trina finally get to rendezvous with the only man she's ever loved? (S1, ep2)

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Kim & Matt
programme.desc: Kim's been pouring her heart out to Matt for over 10 years. Now, Kim's facing a life-changing decision - should she marry her current boyfriend or find out if Matt is her soul mate?

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jasmine & Mike
programme.desc: Jasmine has been texting with Mike for two years and thinks he could be the perfect step-father for her son. Although they live only 15 minutes apart, the pair have yet to meet up in person.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jarrod & Abby

programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.desc: The guys take Big Sis to her first auction - and when things get ugly, she becomes their secret weapon. Ton tests out a "blob" and Allen gets shot with a riot gun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown

programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to a Hollywood auction and face a new competitor with a seemingly endless cash flow. After they uncover a triple barrel shotgun and an antique camel saddle, Allen confronts an old childhood fear.

programme.desc: Eat, Pray, Queef: When a new Canadian show called The Queef Sisters starts a 'queefing' craze the men of South Park are disgusted by this new female craze and move to get it banned. (S13, E04)

programme.desc: W. T. F.: After seeing their first live WWE wrestling match the boys decide to form their own wrestling federation... and gain a huge redneck following! (S13, E10)

programme.title: A Haunting: Heartland Horror
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts his entire life. But after he and his parents return home from a ghost tour in Missouri, strange spirits creep through their home. Nolan undertakes a life-threatening struggle to rid his family of an undaunted evil.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Shadowman
programme.desc: Tim Yancey and his older brother Tom love playing in the woods surrounding their Florida home. One afternoon Tom senses a presence watching him from among the shadows. Days later, the same entity confronts Tim and chases him through the woods.

programme.title: A Haunting: Eternal Grief
programme.desc: Shortly after moving into her home in Indiana, Jennifer Patterson receives a warning from a stranger that she is not alone in the house. When she hears strange voices, she begins to wonder if the previous owner, who died in the house, still inhabits it.

programme.title: A Haunting: Bewitched
programme.desc: All appears to be on track when Sidney moves his pregnant girlfriend into the home he shares with his mother. But their happiness is suddenly shattered when an ex-friend is trying to tear the couple apart through witchcraft and has endangered everyone.

programme.title: A Haunting: House of Nightmares

programme.title: A Haunting: Mind Control
programme.desc: When William falls ill, Amanda Morrison's family volunteer to clean his home. But after the family stumbles across satanic objects in the home, strange things start happening. A demonologist cleanses the home and discovers the reason behind the haunting.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 12

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 15

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 17

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 2
programme.desc: Prince Zuko, a young Firebender whose mission in life is to capture the Avatar, tracks Aang down to the Southern Water Tribe village where Katara and Sokka live.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 3

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 5
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 6
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 7
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 10

programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 12

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 13
